huggingface.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
huggingface.summary: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. huggingface.title: The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models
huggingface.summary: We formalize prefix invariance: representations at position t must not depend on future inputs.
